title: How many languages are there in the world?
examples: How many languages are spoken in the world?
Which continent has the most languages?

items.label: Asia
items.ask: Which continent has the most languages?

explain.say: How many ways can you say hello? Namaste, ni hao, jambo, hola, bonjour... People on Earth speak about 7,000 different languages! Look at the board: each bar shows how many are spoken in one part of the world.

draw.text: How many languages are there in the world?

items.label: Asia
items.ask: Which continent has the most languages?

explain.say: See the longest bar? Asia has the most, about 2,300 languages. India alone has hundreds, and Indonesia more than 700. Can you find the bar for Africa?

items.label: Asia
items.ask: Which continent has the most languages?

explain.say: Africa comes very close, with about 2,100 languages. Nigeria has more than 500! Now look at the Pacific bar: lots of tiny islands, but more than 1,300 languages. Which bar do you think is shortest?

items.label: Asia
items.ask: Which continent has the most languages?

explain.say: It is Europe, with about 290. Surprised? Big languages like English and Spanish spread far from Europe, so it has fewer of its own. Now here is something sad: about four in every ten languages are endangered, which means few children are learning them.

items.label: Asia
items.ask: Which continent has the most languages?

explain.say: Great listening! Here is a challenge: ask your family which languages your grandparents speak. You might be keeping a language alive just by learning a few words.

faq.q: How many languages are spoken in the world?
faq.a: About 7,000 living languages, counting sign languages too. The exact number changes as languages are studied and as some stop being spoken.

faq.q: Which continent has the most languages?
faq.a: Asia has the most, about 2,300, with Africa close behind at about 2,100.
asks: Where are the most languages spoken?

faq.a: A language is endangered when fewer and fewer children learn it, so it could stop being spoken. About four in ten of the world's languages are endangered.

faq.q: Why does Europe have so few languages?
faq.a: Over history, a few big languages spread across Europe and replaced many small ones. Europe has about 290 languages.
asks: How many languages are in Europe?

faq.q: Which country has the most languages?
faq.a: Papua New Guinea, with about 840 languages, more than any other country. Indonesia and Nigeria come next.

facts: There are about 7,000 living languages in the world, according to the Ethnologue catalogue.
Roughly 40 percent of the world's languages are endangered, with fewer and fewer young speakers.

quiz.say: About how many languages are spoken in the world today?
quiz.show: About how many languages are spoken in the world today?

wrong.0: Seventy is far too few; Nigeria alone has more than 500.

quiz.say: What does it mean when a language is endangered?
quiz.show: What does it mean when a language is endangered?
quiz.why: An endangered language may stop being spoken because young people are not learning it.

wrong.1: Endangered has nothing to do with loudness.
wrong.2: Many healthy languages have no writing system; that alone does not make them endangered.
